name: Max reasoning effort (temperature 1.0, top-p 0.95)
description: Results produced with reasoning effort set to its maximum, temperature 1.0, and top-p 0.95. Used by the Kimi K3.1 Pro card ('max' reasoning effort) and the DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash card (reasoning_effort=100, the maximum on DeepSeek's effort scale).

name: 0-shot
description: No in-context exemplars. Used for TruthfulQA (MC2), IFEval, and some MMLU, HumanEval, and WinoGrande reports.

name: 0-shot CoT
description: Zero-shot with chain-of-thought prompting. Used for GPQA Diamond, AIME 2025, MATH-500 (reasoning-model convention), and MMLU-Pro (0-shot CoT providers, e.g. Gemini per the TIGER-Lab note).

name: 3-shot
description: Three exemplars, answer-only. Used for MBPP (standard) and LiveCodeBench 'Pass@1' (DeepSeek convention).

name: 3-shot CoT
description: Three exemplars with chain-of-thought. Used for BBH (standard, official cot-prompts) and LiveCodeBench 'Pass@1-COT' (DeepSeek convention).

name: 4-shot
description: Four exemplars. Used for MATH-500 / MATH final-answer EM (DeepSeek convention).

name: 4-shot CoT
description: Four exemplars with chain-of-thought. Reserved for sources that report MATH-family scores this way.

name: 5-shot
description: Five exemplars. Used for MMLU (standard) and WinoGrande (standard).

name: 5-shot CoT
description: Five exemplars with chain-of-thought. Used for MMLU-Pro (paper and official leaderboard standard).

name: 10-shot
description: Ten exemplars. Used for HellaSwag (standard).

name: pass@1
description: Single-attempt functional correctness where the shot count is undefined by the source (agentic scaffold runs). Used for SWE-bench Verified.

name: pass@1 (mini-SWE-agent)
description: Single-attempt functional correctness on the official swebench.com Verified leaderboard's mini-SWE-agent harness, as opposed to provider self-reported custom scaffolds. Used for SWE-bench Verified leaderboard rows.

name: pass@1 (no thinking)
description: SWE-bench Verified provider-scaffold run with extended thinking disabled (Claude Opus 4.5 system card Table 2.4.A 'no thinking', 200K context, averaged over 5 trials).

name: pass@1 (with thinking)
description: SWE-bench Verified provider-scaffold run with extended thinking enabled (Claude Opus 4.5 system card Table 2.4.A 64k thinking budget, averaged over 5 trials).

name: pass^1
description: First-attempt task success (official tau2-bench notation, verified on taubench.com). Used for tau2-bench.

name: pass^1 (Retail domain)
description: First-attempt task success on the τ²-bench Retail domain, provider self-reported. The domain is recorded in the Evaluation setting because the Score schema has no separate domain field; Retail is τ²-bench's original domain.

name: pass^1 (Telecom domain)
description: First-attempt task success on the τ²-bench Telecom domain, provider self-reported. The domain is recorded in the Evaluation setting because the Score schema has no separate domain field.

name: with thinking
description: Reasoning mode / high effort enabled. Used for ARC-AGI-2 leaderboard entries labeled e.g. 'Grok 4 (Thinking)'.

name: no thinking
description: Reasoning mode disabled. Used for ARC-AGI-2 no-thinking entries.

name: 128k context
description: Long-context evaluation at 128K tokens. Used for RULER. Other lengths (4k/8k/16k/32k/64k context) are added by data PR when a Score needs them.

name: unspecified by source
description: The provider publishes the number in a benchmark table with no shot count, thinking-mode label, or other prompting/decode condition stated. Used for GLM-4.7 (MMLU-Pro 84.3, GPQA Diamond 85.7) and Qwen3.6-27B (MMLU-Pro 86.2, GPQA Diamond 87.8) card-table scores; must not be silently compared with labeled settings.

name: unspecified by source (thinking mode default)
description: The provider's card publishes the score with no shot count or thinking-mode label, while stating the model operates in thinking mode by default (Qwen3.5-27B card: 'Qwen3.5 models operate in thinking mode by default'). Used for Qwen3.5-27B MMLU-Pro 86.1 and GPQA Diamond 85.5; a shot count must not be silently assigned (notes §3).

name: unspecified by source (thinking-only model, reasoning_effort defaults to xhigh)
description: Alibaba's Model Studio page attributes the score to qwen3.8-2.4t-a95b without an evaluation-condition label; the model is thinking-only (thinking cannot be disabled) with reasoning_effort defaulting to xhigh (xhigh/medium/low supported) per its card. Used for Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B GPQA Diamond 92.6.

name: unspecified by source; LiveCodeBench release_v6
description: Card-table LiveCodeBench pass@1 with no shot count stated, on release version v6 (card rows 'LiveCodeBench v6' / 'LiveCodeBench-v6'). Used for Qwen3.5-27B 80.7, GLM-4.7 84.9, and Qwen3.6-27B 83.9. The version is part of the setting because LiveCodeBench cross-version scores are not comparable; the vocabulary's shot-string entries carry no version.

name: unspecified by source (pass@1 convention; AIME I/II split not stated)
description: Card-table AIME 2025 score with no shot count stated; the card does not say whether the number covers AIME I, AIME II, or both, nor the run count. Used for GLM-4.7 AIME 2025 95.7 (pass@1 is the benchmark metric; the prompting condition is unspecified).

name: unspecified by source (temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95, max generation 163,840 tokens)
description: GLM-5.2's card has no setting statement for its GPQA Diamond row; its reasoning footnote (for 'HLE & other reasoning tasks') gives temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95, and max generation 163,840 tokens, with no shot/mode label for GPQA — it is unclear whether the footnote's parameters apply to the GPQA score. Used for GLM-5.2 GPQA Diamond 91.2.

name: no tools, avg@32 (thinking model, temp 1.0, top-p 0.95, 256k context, 96k completion budget)
description: Kimi K2.5 AIME 2025 condition per the model card's Testing Details: no tools, thinking mode, temperature 1.0, top-p 0.95, 256k context, 96k maximum completion budget; AIME results averaged over 32 runs (avg@32).

name: no tools, avg@8 (thinking model, temp 1.0, top-p 0.95, 256k context, 96k completion budget)
description: Kimi K2.5 GPQA-Diamond condition per the model card's Testing Details: no tools, thinking mode, temperature 1.0, top-p 0.95, 256k context, 96k completion budget; GPQA-Diamond averaged over 8 runs (avg@8).

name: no tools (thinking model, temp 1.0, top-p 0.95, 256k context)
description: Kimi K2.5 MMLU-Pro condition per the model card: no tools, thinking mode, temperature 1.0, top-p 0.95, 256k context; no shot count stated on the card.

name: no tools, thinking mode, LiveCodeBench v6, average of 5 runs (temp 1.0, top-p 0.95, 256k context)
description: Kimi K2.5 LiveCodeBench (v6) condition per the model card: no tools, thinking mode, temperature 1.0, top-p 0.95, 256k context, coding-task scores averaged over 5 independent runs; no shot count stated.

name: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index methodology (MiniMax self-run, AA-aligned)
description: MiniMax-M2 Intelligence Benchmarks rows (AIME25, MMLU-Pro, GPQA-Diamond): scores aligned with the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Benchmarking Methodology (https://artificialanalysis.ai/methodology/intelligence-benchmarking), run by MiniMax; shot count not stated on the card.

name: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index methodology (MiniMax self-run, AA-aligned; version/variant not stated on card)
description: MiniMax-M2 LiveCodeBench row: aligned with the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Benchmarking Methodology, run by MiniMax; the card does not state the LiveCodeBench release version or the Pass@1 vs Pass@1-COT variant.

name: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index methodology (MiniMax internal testing on public eval sets)
description: MiniMax-M2.5 appendix rows (AIME25, GPQA-D): obtained through internal testing based on the public evaluation sets and evaluation methods covered by the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index leaderboard; shot count not stated.

name: 0-shot, pass@1, custom window 2024-10-01 to 2025-02-01
description: Meta's Llama 4 Maverick card reports LiveCodeBench as 0-shot pass@1 over a custom time window (2024-10-01 to 2025-02-01), which is not a LiveCodeBench release_v1–v6 window; not directly comparable to release-version scores.

name: no tools, avg@32 (temp 1.0, 256k context, 96k thinking budget)
description: Kimi K2 Thinking AIME25 condition per the model card: no tools, temperature 1.0, 256k context, 96k thinking-token budget; AIME reported as avg@32.

name: no tools (temp 1.0, 256k context)
description: Kimi K2 Thinking MMLU-Pro condition per the model card: no tools, temperature 1.0, 256k context; no shot count stated.

name: no tools, LiveCodeBench V6 (temp 1.0, 128k thinking budget)
description: Kimi K2 Thinking LiveCodeBench V6 condition per the model card: no tools, temperature 1.0, 128k thinking-token budget; no shot count stated.

name: no tools
description: GPQA Diamond as published in the GPT-6.2 Astra/Sol system card: the card's exact row label is 'GPQA Diamond (no tools)' — accuracy, closed-book, the model selects one of four answers without external tools; the card states no shot count or CoT mode. Provider-reported setting (GPT-6.2 Astra 97.0, GPT-6.2 Sol 96.0).

name: semi-private, max reasoning effort
description: ARC Prize leaderboard (arcprize.org), ARC-AGI-2 (v2 semi-private set), evaluated with 'max' reasoning effort using the standard harness. Rows: GPT-6.2 Astra 95.8 (openai-gpt-6-2-astra-max, $0.970/task), GPT-6.2 Sol 85.8 (openai-gpt-6-2-sol-max, $0.261/task; partial dataset coverage — scores use full catalog denominators).

name: semi-private, high reasoning effort
description: ARC Prize leaderboard (arcprize.org), ARC-AGI-2 (v2 semi-private set), evaluated with 'high' reasoning effort using the standard harness. Row: GPT-6.2 Astra 94.6 (openai-gpt-6-2-astra-high, $0.408/task).

name: semi-private, medium reasoning effort
description: ARC Prize leaderboard (arcprize.org), ARC-AGI-2 (v2 semi-private set), evaluated with 'medium' reasoning effort using the standard harness. Row: GPT-6.2 Sol 82.9 (openai-gpt-6-2-sol-medium, $0.103/task; partial dataset coverage note on the row).
